explication: The Public Suffix List is both a maintained domain-rule dataset and tooling for editing, validating, and using it. A contributor’s workflow runs through the psltool command interface, which parses and validates list data; the parser relies on domain-name handling, while online checks can consult GitHub and local history. The repository also provides suffix lookup, a standalone syntax linter, gTLD-list generation, and a private-domain review utility. Edges reflect excerpts, the source index, or README; unsampled internals are not inferred.
